purpose: Compare three fitting objectives while holding all process equations, priors, data and folds fixed.

objectives.O0_LOG_T4: registered station/tree weighted Student-t likelihood on ln(1+TN)
objectives.O1_HET_T4: Student-t likelihood on TN mg/L with scale exp(log_sigma)*(0.25+prediction)

optimizer.method: deterministic warm-start block-coordinate AdamW + strong-Wolfe LBFGS
optimizer.single_warm_start: same-fold prior MINERAL_LIFETIME process and raw station effects
optimizer.retry: one deterministic zero-site retry only after nonfinite result

primary_gate_rows: exclude reach_id=17 and terminal_tree_id=163; preserve both in diagnostics

eligibility.log_rmse: population and conditional station/tree paired bootstrap CI95 upper < 0.005 relative to O0
eligibility.dynamics: conditional paired station-NSE delta CI95 lower > 0 and population point station-NSE delta >= 0
eligibility.selection: eligible candidate with highest conditional station-median NSE; if multiple candidates are not significantly ordered, declare no unique winner and stop

fallback: If neither alternative is dynamically eligible, retain O0 as the unique objective winner.
authorized_successor: 20260831_4 only after a unique winner is locked
